jobDescription:
Senior Cloud Platform Engineer

Location: Munich, Germany / Hybrid
Employment: Full-time

About the Role
We are expanding our platform team and are looking for a Senior Cloud Platform Engineer to design, automate, and operate the infrastructure our product teams build on. You will own our AWS estate, our Kubernetes platform, and the infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD tooling that ties them together.

Key Responsibilities
- Design and operate multi-account AWS infrastructure at scale.
- Run and harden our production Kubernetes clusters.
- Own infrastructure-as-code with Terraform across all environments.
- Build and maintain container images and the CI/CD pipelines that ship them.
- Automate operational tooling and platform services.
- Partner with product teams as platform consultants and mentors.

Required Skills
- Strong hands-on AWS experience across compute, networking, and IAM
- Production Kubernetes operations
- Terraform for infrastructure-as-code
- Docker and container image management
- Python for automation and tooling
- CI/CD pipeline design
- Strong troubleshooting and on-call experience

Required Certifications
- AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
- Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
- HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate

Languages
- German (business fluent) — required for internal collaboration
- English (professional working proficiency)

Nice to Have
- Go for platform tooling
- Service mesh experience
- FinOps / cloud cost optimization
resume:
Lukas Weber
Senior Cloud Platform Engineer

Location: Munich, Germany
Languages: German (native), English (C1, professional)

Professional Summary
Cloud platform engineer with 8 years designing and operating AWS infrastructure and Kubernetes platforms for product engineering teams. I focus on infrastructure-as-code, safe delivery pipelines, and giving developers a paved road to production.

Professional Experience

Senior Cloud Platform Engineer — Alpsystem GmbH, Munich (2020–present)
- Own a multi-account AWS estate spanning compute, VPC networking, and IAM for 40+ product teams.
- Operate production Kubernetes clusters end to end, including upgrades, capacity planning, and on-call incident response.
- Manage all infrastructure as code in Terraform, with remote state, module registries, and peer-reviewed plans on every change.
- Build and maintain the container images for platform services and tune multi-stage Docker builds for size and cache reuse.
- Design the GitLab CI pipelines that lint, test, and progressively deliver every platform component.
- Write operational tooling and automation in Python, from cost reports to cluster maintenance jobs.

Cloud Engineer — Rheindata AG, Cologne (2016–2020)
- Migrated on-prem workloads to AWS and introduced Terraform as the team's infrastructure-as-code standard.
- Automated build and release workflows and containerized legacy services with Docker.

Certifications
- AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (2022)
- AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate (2021)

Currently working toward, but not yet certified:
- Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)

Note: I hold no HashiCorp certification, though Terraform is part of my daily work.

Education
Dipl.-Ing. Computer Science — Technical University of Munich
